pages.name: Orders
pages.source:
Page(name: "Orders", route: Route(path: "/orders"))

usingClient(
  orders<Order[]>(src: Tenant.history(limit: 20)),
  me<Me>(src: Tenant.me()),
)

Build(
  Column(gap: Space.md, children: [
    Text(child: "Hi ${me.display_name}"),
    Text(child: "${orders.length} orders"),
  ])
)
